searchText: What I take of that thread is that the cost of catering at an ACD meeting meant something just a couple of years ago Its just a start but feel free to checkout https://www.gasprice.io/ and let me know if you have any suggestions or feedback. What does fee cap means? I believe "maxFeePerGas" People hate using the standard/descriptive names for anything for some reason. I suppose it's the max ... Atgh <@301186049323958275> beat me I'd love to see an oracle that tells me what is a reasonable base fee and priority fee that I need to use for 1,5 and 20 blocks inclusion You mean you want an AI that speculates on future Ethereum demand on your behalf? Watchtheburn is what I use to see what are the last 20 blocks You can right click or long-press on a message in Discord to edit it. No need to post follow-up correction messages like crappy platforms (Twitter). I'm not a fan of the Instant/Fast/Eco stuff. I am a fan of the "current cost of different types of transactions" table though. I also like the "cheapest day of the week" and "lowest base fee" things (though I think 54 being the 30 day low is incorrect as I'm pretty sure I have got things included below 54 in the last month). Off off topic: someone went out of their way in designing your role avatar, it's perfect Cheapest time of day (in both UTC and local time zone) would be cool. Also, the timestamps should indicate whether they are UTC or local. Ty Anything you’d like to see added? Adding to that, a very useful feature of watchtheburn is the base fee chart if only they had longer axes. For people that are willing to wait, a daily chart would be awesome The various visualizations are neat. Would be cool to see a historic version of the Deep Transaction Analysis chart. Yeah, 24 hour base fee low and 7 day base fee low would be nice, as well as 5th, and 10th percentiles for each. Ty I’ll forward all this on to the devs Oh I now see you have those charts but for some reason in this cell as soon as I put my finger on them they zoom in, and I can't zoom back out Are there any apis that would be useful to you? Or traders/users in general? It’s not optimized for mobile yet 😂 Maybe have 3 base fee charts (1 hour, 24 hour, 7 days) and draw a lowest, 5th percentile, and 50th percentile line on it or something. Chart coloring based on *when* it was below each line would be an added bonus. Then you could easily see what some good historic prices are based on your willingness to wait. Thanks if you think of anything else let me know <@636289909359116290> the issue with naming is interesting. I don't use wallets much and don't interact with apps much either, but the little I do shows that there's no standard naming at least post London. My intuition would be to give averages or last values for the baseFeePerGas and priorityFee. And then recommend the maxFeePerGas and priorityFee accordingl, but naming them so. I find it weird that I have to guess what each field in metamask or whatever site I'm seeing means. Typically the meaning is clear, but the fact that they chose a different name makes me look in their documentation just to make sure, that doesn't make any sense Yep! Definitely needs to be better documentation and standardization <@636289909359116290> The "Lowest base fee" is definitely broken. Just dipped to 52 and the site still shows 54 as the lowest in the last 30 days. will check Ah it’s per minute not second you cna also hit the ⬆️ and it will edit your last message
